note: applejack. Learning: benched bet types (no singles): points overs, assists overs, game overs, +2.5 puck lines. Adopted filters: H1 (no points unders on PP1 players), H3/H10 (model 8+ pts above Pinnacle) - H10 removed Minnesota-Toronto Under 7.5 (our top raw estimate, 82.3%, model 8.9 pts above market). Graded ledger: 1,483 rows (mostly Nov 10-11, so still provisional). 1,076 options priced and logged tonight across 10 games. Most singles are +1.5 puck lines whose estimate clears break-even only because of the learned +1.5 bias (H11, still testing); each pick says so. One pick per game. Agents: Agent 2's blind top 4 were all shorter than -300, so its replacement top 4 (given after seeing ours) was used; Agent 3 independently named Ottawa +1.5. Utah, Detroit and Toronto +1.5 got Pass votes from Agents 2 and 3. Teams on the 2nd night of a back-to-back: Tampa Bay, Buffalo, Utah. Goalies per RotoWire/Daily Faceoff ~3:45 PM ET: Hildeby (TBL), Ellis (BUF), Knight (CHI), Thompson (WSH), Vejmelka (UTA), Sorokin (NYI) expected or likely, not confirmed. Re-check goalies before betting.
